title: Debrief
description: incidents/{id}/debriefs/{segmentId}: after a segment is cleared, how long it took and what worked or did not. Command writes any; a member writes only for a segment they cleared (clearedEventId points at their own cleared event). Command alone edits. The engine never reads it, so no coverage claim comes from it.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp of the first write (request.time).

clearedEventId.description: The writer's own cleared event for this segment; required unless command writes it.
